Dear Miss Yonge,
[I](/person/939) enclose the [monthly cheque](/topic/160) with best remembrances.
I hope the [Cameos](/book/73) will get out by & by.

The volume proves thinner than I had expected and I am making calculations as to price.

This first edition at 4/6 or even 5/- will not yield much.

Are you disposed to sell us the copy right?

Yours very faithfully
A.

Macmillan
